summary: Russia launched a massive wave of Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones targeting Kyiv and at least 10 Ukrainian regions overnight, striking critical infrastructure including Darnytska TEC-4, a high-rise in Darnytskyi district, and the Capital Market, killing at least three civilians and injuring over 10. Ukrainian air defenses tracked multiple groups of UAVs across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Cherkasy, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Vinnytsia, Odesa, and Kirovohrad regions. Ukraine's military intelligence chief Budanov announced mass deployment of interceptor drones within months, with prototypes already downing enemy UAVs in combat tests.
key_points: Geran-5 missile struck Darnytska TEC-4 power plant in Kyiv overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75805)
At least 7 Geran-5 missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region, with multiple impacting Kyiv suburbs including Vinogradar and Zhytomyr. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75826)
Russian drone hit residential high-rise in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district, injuring one person. (Source: @UkraineNow/84343)
Attack on Capital Market in Sofiivska Borshchahivka killed two and injured approximately 10 civilians. (Source: @UkraineNow/84350)
Vehicle service center and over 30 vehicles destroyed in Kyiv drone strike, gas station and offices damaged. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33554)
Ukrainian drone manufacturer Pegasus Arms halted operations after two Russian missile strikes on production facilities in September. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33557)
Budanov stated Ukraine will mass-produce interceptor drones within months; prototypes already destroying enemy UAVs in combat. (Source: @UkraineNow/84330)
DeepState map shows Russian forces advanced near Bilytskyi on eastern front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23864)

points: Ukrainian air defense units tracked and reported multiple groups of reactive Shahed UAVs and Geran-5 missiles across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Cherkasy, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Vinnytsia, Odesa, and Kirovohrad regions throughout the night, with specific trajectories monitored via radar channels. Military intelligence chief Kyrylo Budanov confirmed Ukraine will begin mass application of interceptor drones within months, stating prototypes are already tested in combat conditions and successfully shooting down enemy UAVs, with focus now on scaling production. (Source: @UkraineNow/84330)
A large prisoner exchange may occur next week, according to Budanov's statement during a televised interview. (Source: @UkraineNow/84330)

Ukrainian drone manufacturer Pegasus Arms suspended operations indefinitely after its production facility was damaged by Russian missile strikes on September 2 and again on September 23–24 after relocation, severely degrading domestic UAV production capacity. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33557)

Civilian casualties reported in Kyiv: one man killed in Solomianskyi district during fire at strike site, one injured in Darnytskyi district high-rise hit, two killed and approximately 10 injured at Capital Market in Sofiivska Borshchahivka. (Source: @UkraineNow/84328, @UkraineNow/84343, @UkraineNow/84350)

Critical infrastructure damage includes Darnytska TEC-4 power plant hit, Zammler transport company warehouses burning in Brovary, vehicle service center with over 30 vehicles destroyed in Kyiv, Kärcher warehouse destroyed with equipment and products burned, and Epicentr hypermarket in Odesa burned overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75805, @UkraineNow/84328, @ukr_leaks_eng/33554, @UkraineNow/84341, @ukr_leaks_eng/33546)
Kyiv air raid alert lifted at 00:56 on 28.09.2026 after drone threat (yellow level) subsided, indicating sustained overnight aerial pressure on the capital. (Source: @eRadarrua/117883)

Russian forces launched at least 5 groups of strike UAVs from Orel region overnight, alongside multiple Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones from Bryansk, Chernihiv, Sumy, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia, Donetsk, Poltava, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, and Rivne regions, demonstrating coordinated multi-axis aerial attack. (Source: @eRadarrua/117765, @mon1tor_ua/75821, @mon1tor_ua/75823, @mon1tor_ua/75826, @mon1tor_ua/75830, @mon1tor_ua/75836, @mon1tor_ua/75838)

Geran-5 missiles specifically targeted Kyiv from Chernihiv region (7 missiles), Zhytomyr (impacting Zhytomyr city and Vinogradar), Rivne (hitting Zdolbuniv and approaching Rivne city), and Vinnytsia region, with trajectories tracked in real-time by monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75826, @mon1tor_ua/75824, @mon1tor_ua/75827, @mon1tor_ua/75828, @mon1tor_ua/75830, @mon1tor_ua/75836, @mon1tor_ua/75838)

Reactive Shahed UAVs deployed from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod district), from Sumy to Chernihiv (Nizhyn district), from Cherkasy to Kyiv (Bila Tserkva district), from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi, from Donetsk to Dnipropetrovsk (Pavlohrad district), from Poltava to Cherkasy, from Odesa to Vinnytsia (Haisyn district), and from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava (Kremenchuk district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75821, @mon1tor_ua/75823, @mon1tor_ua/75802)

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed 43 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions during the day, indicating ongoing Ukrainian long-range drone operations against Russian territory. (Source: @tass_agency/397599)
Russian MoD described strikes on Ukrainian data centers as "digital detox," framing cyber-physical attacks on critical digital infrastructure as a deliberate campaign. (Source: @UkraineNow/84344)

Russian missile strikes precisely targeted Ukrainian drone production facilities, hitting Pegasus Arms workshops twice in September, forcing indefinite suspension of operations and degrading Ukraine's indigenous UAV manufacturing. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33557)

Lavrov accused Europe of preparing for armed confrontation with Russia, stating European rearmament investments risk becoming a self-fulfilling prophecy, reflecting Russian strategic narrative to justify continued aggression. (Source: @UkraineNow/84332)
DeepState map update confirms Russian forces advanced near Bilytskyi, indicating continued incremental gains in the eastern sector despite Ukrainian defensive efforts. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23864)

Russian strike UAV groups originating from Donetsk region targeted Dnipropetrovsk region's Pavlohrad district, suggesting coordination between frontline operations and deep rear strikes. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75823)
No specific Ukrainian counteroffensive actions or territorial changes reported in eastern front messages for this period.
Absence of detailed frontline contact reports suggests current focus remains on long-range strike campaign rather than ground maneuver in eastern sector.

Chernihiv region served as major launch corridor for Russian Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shaheds toward Kyiv region, with at least 7 Geran-5 missiles and multiple Shahed groups tracked from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod district) and from Bryansk region to Chernihiv (Chernihiv district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75821, @mon1tor_ua/75823, @mon1tor_ua/75826, @mon1tor_ua/75802)

Russian forces maintain ability to operate UAVs from Belarusian direction (Bryansk region) and Russian territory (Orel, Kursk implied) against northern Ukrainian regions.

Odesa region experienced reactive Shahed UAV transit past Ananiv toward Vinnytsia, and strike UAV groups on course to Artsyz and Sarata near Danube delta, indicating southern vector pressure. (Source: @kpszsu/80793, @kpszsu/80803)
Epicentr hypermarket in Odesa burned down overnight in suspected Russian strike, adding to pattern of commercial infrastructure targeting in southern Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33546)
Reactive Shahed UAV directed toward Odesa from north detected, suggesting continued threat to port and logistics infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/80781)
No reports of ground combat changes in Kherson or Zaporizhzhia sectors; southern front activity dominated by long-range drone operations.

Massive overnight aerial attack involved Geran-5 missiles (rocket-powered Shahed variants) and reactive Shahed UAVs launched from at least 10 origin regions: Orel, Bryansk, Chernihiv, Sumy, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia, Donetsk, Poltava, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, Rivne, targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Cherkasy, Chernihiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk regions. sections.threat_assessment: Russia's overnight massed Geran-5 and reactive Shahed attack across 10+ Ukrainian regions demonstrates improved coordination of multi-axis long-range strike capabilities, with Chernihiv region emerging as a primary launch corridor for Kyiv-targeted missiles. The precision hits on Darnytska TEC-4, a residential high-rise, and the Capital Market indicate deliberate targeting of energy, civilian, and commercial infrastructure to maximize psychological and economic impact. Simultaneous strikes on Ukrainian drone production facilities (Pegasus Arms) reveal a systematic effort to degrade Ukraine's indigenous UAV industrial base ahead of winter. Ukraine's announced interceptor drone deployment could partially offset Shahed cost-asymmetry within months, but current air defense saturation remains a critical vulnerability. Russian ground advances near Bilytskyi suggest the aerial campaign is synchronized with localized offensive pressure on the eastern front.
